name: Standard Contract Terms
description: Baseline business terms for a scoped freelance project.
content:
# Contract Terms: {{projectName}}

This template is for general business use only and does not constitute legal advice.

## Parties
These terms outline the working arrangement between {{businessName}} and {{clientName}} for {{projectName}}.

## Service Scope
{{scope}}

## Payment Terms
The project fee is {{currency}} {{price}}. Payment timing, deposit requirements, and final payment due dates should be confirmed in writing before work begins.

## Revisions
The project includes up to two reasonable revision rounds unless a different revision limit is agreed in writing.

## Delivery Timeline
Work is expected to begin on {{startDate}} and target completion by {{dueDate}}, subject to timely feedback, access, and approvals from the client.

## Delay Handling
If required information, feedback, or approvals are delayed, the delivery timeline may be extended accordingly. Material scope changes may require a revised timeline and fee.

## Cancellation Policy
Either party may cancel the engagement in writing. Work completed before cancellation remains payable, including approved milestones and reasonable committed costs.

## Intellectual Property
Upon full payment, final approved deliverables prepared specifically for the client are assigned to the client, except for pre-existing tools, templates, methods, third-party assets, and portfolio rights unless otherwise agreed.

## Confidentiality
Both parties agree to handle non-public business information with reasonable care and not disclose it except as required to complete the project or by law.

## Disclaimer
These terms are a general business template and may not address all legal, regulatory, or jurisdiction-specific requirements. The parties should seek qualified legal advice where appropriate.
